app_fee.value: The application fee is $70 and is nonrefundable.

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers are limited to specific cohorts such as McNair, Project 1000, GEM scholars, U.S. military/veterans using GI Bill benefits, and Rutgers-Newark SURI program alumni; general international applicants are not eligible.
fee_waiver.quote: If you are a McNair, Project 1000, GEM, or other scholar, you may be eligible for an application fee waiver. | Applicants who are currently serving in the U.S. Military or are Military Veterans who plan to apply for educational benefits under the GI Bill, receive a waiver of the application fee.

also.quote: Program alumni are eligible for application fee waivers when applying to Rutgers Graduate School-Newark.

gre_general.value: No university-wide GRE General policy is set by Graduate School-Newark; individual programs set their own GRE rules.

toefl_min.value: Graduate admissions sets section minimums rather than an overall total: Writing 22, Speaking 23, Reading 21, and Listening 17 on the 0-120 scale (or Writing 4.5, Speaking 4.5, Reading 4, and Listening 4 on the new scale). Some programs state their own thresholds.
toefl_min.quote: Writing 22, Speaking 23, Reading 21, and Listening 17 | Writing 4.5, Speaking 4.5, Reading 4, and Listening 4

ielts_min.value: Minimum overall IELTS score for admission consideration is band 7 (some departments state different minimums).
ielts_min.quote: Minimum overall IELTS score for admission consideration is a bandwidth 7

english_waiver.value: An English proficiency test waiver may be requested case by case if your entire degree was completed at an institution where English is the principal language of instruction; India is not automatically exempt.
english_waiver.quote: The English proficiency test requirement may be waived for applicants who have completed their entire degree at an institution where English is the principal language of instruction. | Requests for waivers are reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

notes: Public Carnegie R2 campus of Rutgers University in Newark, New Jersey. Graduate School-Newark offers 12 Ph.D. programs in total, 6 of which map to the 18 STEM Atlas fields: Biology (federated with NJIT), Chemistry, Environmental Sciences, Mathematical Sciences (pure mathematics and data science tracks), Neuroscience (CMBN), and Applied Physics (joint with NJIT). The other 6 Ph.D. programs are non-STEM (American Studies, Criminal Justice, Global Urban Studies, Management, Psychology, and Public Administration). Note Psychology offers a Neuroscience training area alongside CMBN's dedicated Ph.D. in Neuroscience.
